```{r}
# Loading the data

load_data = function(folder, file) {
  file_path = file.path(folder, file)
  df = read_excel(
    path = file_path,
    sheet = 1
  )
  df = subset(df, select = -c(layer_title))
  return(df)
}

core_3A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_A.xlsx")
core_3B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_B.xlsx")

core_4A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_A.xlsx")
core_4B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_B.xlsx")



## Concatenating the top (A) and bottom (B) parts of the cores

core_3 = bind_rows(
  core_3A,
  core_3B |> mutate(depth_mm = depth_mm + max(core_3A$depth_mm))
)

core_4 = bind_rows(
```

```{r}
# Helper functions for smoothing and detrending
smooth = function(x, window) {
  as.numeric(
    stats::filter(x, rep(1/window, window), sides = 2)
  )
}
detrend = function(x, window) {
  x - smooth(x, window)
}

# Applying across all cores and window sizes (creating new cols)
for (window in c(5, 11, 21)) {
  for (core_name in c("core_3", "core_4", "core_3A", "core_3B", "core_4A", "core_4B")) {
    
    df = get(core_name)
    for (axis in c("L_star", "a_star", "b_star")) {
      df[[paste0(axis, "_smooth_", window)]] =
        smooth(df[[axis]], window)
      df[[paste0(axis, "_detrend_", window)]] =
        detrend(df[[axis]], window)
    }
    assign(core_name, df)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Plotting a single dimension from multiple cores
plot_series = function(..., axis) {

  series_list = list(...)
  series_names = as.character(substitute(list(...)))[-1]

  plot_df = bind_rows(
    lapply(
      seq_along(series_list),
      function(i) {
        series_list[[i]] |>
          mutate(series = series_names[i])
      }
    )
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[axis]]), !is.na(depth_mm))

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[axis]], y = depth_mm)) +
    geom_path(colour = "blue") +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    facet_wrap(~ series, nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      x = axis
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 5
    )
}


plot_series(
  core_3B,
  core_4B,
  axis = "L_star_smooth_11"
)
```

```{r}

cross_correlate = function(
  series_1,
  series_2,
  axis,
  depth_step = 0.5,
  max_lag_mm = 1000
) {

  # Common depth grid
  depth = seq(
    min(series_1$depth_mm),
    max(series_1$depth_mm),
    by = depth_step
  )

  # Interpolate onto common depth grid
  x1 = approx(
    x = series_1$depth_mm,
    y = series_1[[axis]],
    xout = depth,
    ties = mean
  )$y

  x2 = approx(
    x = series_2$depth_mm,
    y = series_2[[axis]],
    xout = depth,
    ties = mean
  )$y

  # Remove positions where either profile is NA
  valid = !is.na(x1) & !is.na(x2)

  x1 = x1[valid]
  x2 = x2[valid]

  # Cross-correlation
  result = ccf(
    x1,
    x2,
    lag.max = max_lag_mm / depth_step,
    plot = FALSE
  )

  # Convert lag to depth
  data.frame(
    lag_mm = as.vector(result$lag) * depth_step,
    correlation = as.vector(result$acf)
  )
}



ccf_result = cross_correlate(
  core_3B,
  core_4B,
  axis = "L_star_smooth_11"
)
```

```{r}
get_peak = function(ccf_result) {

  i = which.max(ccf_result$correlation)

  data.frame(
    correlation = ccf_result$correlation[i],
    offset_mm = ccf_result$lag_mm[i]
  )
}

peak = get_peak(ccf_result)
```



```{r}
plot_ccf = function(ccf_result, peak) {

  ggplot(ccf_result, aes(x = lag_mm, y = correlation)) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      aes(
        xend = lag_mm,
        y = 0,
        yend = correlation
      ),
      colour = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +

    geom_segment(
      data = peak,
      aes(
        x = offset_mm,
        xend = offset_mm,
        y = 0,
        yend = correlation
      ),
      colour = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = peak,
      aes(
        x = offset_mm,
        y = correlation,
        label = paste0(
          round(offset_mm, 1), " mm ",
          "(r = ", round(correlation, 2), ")"
        )
      ),
      vjust = -0.7,
      size = 3,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    labs(
      x = "Lag (mm)",
      y = "Pearson correlation (r)"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11)
}
```

```{r}

plot_core_images = function(
  image_1,
  image_2,
  series_1,
  series_2,
  offset_mm
) {

  # Cropping an image to the rows represented by its data
  crop_to_data = function(image, series) {

    info = image_info(image)

    image_width = info$width
    image_height = info$height

    row_min = floor(min(series$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))
    row_max = ceiling(max(series$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))

    row_min = max(0, row_min)
    row_max = min(image_height, row_max)

    crop_height = row_max - row_min

    image_crop(
      image,
      geometry = paste0(
        image_width,
        "x",
        crop_height,
        "+0+",
        row_min
      )
    )
  }

  image_1_crop = crop_to_data(image_1, series_1)
  image_2_crop = crop_to_data(image_2, series_2)

  raster_1 = as.raster(image_1_crop)
  raster_2 = as.raster(image_2_crop)

  depth_1_min = min(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  depth_1_max = max(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)

  depth_2_min = min(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE) + offset_mm
  depth_2_max = max(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE) + offset_mm

  ggplot() +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_1,
      xmin = 0,
      xmax = 1,
      ymin = depth_1_min,
      ymax = depth_1_max,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_2,
      xmin = 1.1,
      xmax = 2.1,
      ymin = depth_2_min,
      ymax = depth_2_max,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(
        max(depth_1_max, depth_2_max),
        min(depth_1_min, depth_2_min)
      ),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0.5, 1.6),
      labels = c("Series 1", "Series 2"),
      limits = c(-0.05, 2.15),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Depth (mm)",
      caption = paste0(
        "Series 2 offset by ",
        round(offset_mm, 1),
        " mm."
      )
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 4,
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 8,
        hjust = 0
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_correlation = function(
  series_1,
  series_2,
  image_1,
  image_2,
  axis,
  depth_step = 0.5,
  max_lag_mm = 1000,
  show_plots = TRUE
) {

  # Cross-correlation
  ccf_result = cross_correlate(
    series_1,
    series_2,
    axis = axis,
    depth_step = depth_step,
    max_lag_mm = max_lag_mm
  )

  # Best correlation
  peak = get_peak(ccf_result)

  # Translate second series
  series_2_translated = series_2 |>
    mutate(
      depth_mm = depth_mm + peak$offset_mm
    )

  # Plots
  ccf_plot = plot_ccf(
    ccf_result,
    peak
  )

  image_plot = plot_core_images(
    image_1,
    image_2,
    series_1,
    series_2,
    offset_mm = peak$offset_mm
  )

  # Print plots
  if (show_plots) {
    print(ccf_plot)
    print(image_plot)
  }

  # Return everything
  invisible(list(
    ccf_result = ccf_result,
    peak = peak,
    series_2_translated = series_2_translated,
    ccf_plot = ccf_plot,
    image_plot = image_plot
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Offsets from correlation
offset_A_mm = result_A$peak$offset_mm
offset_B_mm = result_B$peak$offset_mm


# Depth ranges after internal alignment
depth_1A = range(core_3A$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
depth_2A = range(core_4A$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE) + offset_A_mm

depth_1B = range(core_3B$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
depth_2B = range(core_4B$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE) + offset_B_mm


# Drop the A pair onto the B pair
shift_1 = depth_1B[1] - depth_1A[2]
shift_2 = depth_2B[1] - depth_2A[2]

A_shift = min(shift_1, shift_2)


# Apply the same rigid translation to both A cores
depth_1A = depth_1A + A_shift
depth_2A = depth_2A + A_shift


# Overall plot limits
depth_min = min(
  depth_1A[1],
  depth_2A[1],
  depth_1B[1],

)

plot_core_images_4 = function(
  image_1A,
  image_2A,
  image_1B,
  image_2B,
  series_1A,
  series_2A,
  series_1B,
  series_2B,
  depth_1A,
  depth_2A,
  depth_1B,
  depth_2B,
  depth_min,
  depth_max,
  axis
) {

  # Cropping an image to the rows represented by its data
  crop_to_data = function(image, series) {

    info = image_info(image)

    image_width = info$width
    image_height = info$height

    row_min = floor(min(series$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))
    row_max = ceiling(max(series$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))

    row_min = max(0, row_min)
    row_max = min(image_height, row_max)

    crop_height = row_max - row_min

    image_crop(
      image,
      geometry = paste0(
        image_width,
        "x",
        crop_height,
        "+0+",
        row_min
      )
    )
  }


  # Convert the original series depths onto their plotted depths
  transform_depth = function(series, depth_range) {

    original_range = range(
      series$depth_mm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    depth_range[1] +
      (series$depth_mm - original_range[1]) /
      diff(original_range) *
      diff(depth_range)
  }


  # Crop images
  raster_1A = as.raster(
    crop_to_data(image_1A, series_1A)
  )

  raster_2A = as.raster(
    crop_to_data(image_2A, series_2A)
  )

  raster_1B = as.raster(
    crop_to_data(image_1B, series_1B)
  )

  raster_2B = as.raster(
    crop_to_data(image_2B, series_2B)
  )


  # Profile data
  profile_1A = data.frame(
    value = series_1A[[axis]],
    depth_mm = transform_depth(series_1A, depth_1A),
    section = "A"
  )

  profile_1B = data.frame(
    value = series_1B[[axis]],
    depth_mm = transform_depth(series_1B, depth_1B),
    section = "B"
  )

  profile_2A = data.frame(
    value = series_2A[[axis]],
    depth_mm = transform_depth(series_2A, depth_2A),
    section = "A"
  )

  profile_2B = data.frame(
    value = series_2B[[axis]],
    depth_mm = transform_depth(series_2B, depth_2B),
    section = "B"
  )


  # Core image plot
  image_plot = ggplot() +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_1A,
      xmin = 0,
      xmax = 1,
      ymin = depth_1A[1],
      ymax = depth_1A[2],
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_2A,
      xmin = 1.1,
      xmax = 2.1,
      ymin = depth_2A[1],
      ymax = depth_2A[2],
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_1B,
      xmin = 0,
      xmax = 1,
      ymin = depth_1B[1],
      ymax = depth_1B[2],
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_2B,
      xmin = 1.1,
      xmax = 2.1,
      ymin = depth_2B[1],
      ymax = depth_2B[2],
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(depth_max, depth_min),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0.5, 1.6),
      labels = c("Series 1", "Series 2"),
      limits = c(-0.05, 2.15),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Depth (mm)"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 10)


  # Series 1 profile
  profile_plot_1 = bind_rows(
    profile_1A,
    profile_1B
  ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(value),
      !is.na(depth_mm)
    ) |>
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = value,
        y = depth_mm,
        colour = section,
        group = section
      )
    ) +

    geom_path(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(depth_max, depth_min),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = axis,
      y = NULL,
      colour = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )


  # Series 2 profile
  profile_plot_2 = bind_rows(
    profile_2A,
    profile_2B
  ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(value),
      !is.na(depth_mm)
    ) |>
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = value,
        y = depth_mm,
        colour = section,
        group = section
      )
    ) +

    geom_path(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(depth_max, depth_min),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      x = axis,
      y = NULL,
      colour = NULL
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )


  # Combine image and profile plots
  image_plot +
    profile_plot_1 +
    profile_plot_2 +
    patchwork::plot_layout(
      widths = c(2, 1, 1)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dtw)

# ============================================================
# CONSTRAINED DTW
#
# MI-24-03B = fixed reference
# MI-24-04B = core being stretched/compressed
# ============================================================

align_cores_dtw = function(
  x1,
  x2,
  depth,
  valid,
  results,
  depth_step = 0.5,
  max_warp_mm = 50
) {

  # Use the strongest cross-correlation peak as the
  # initial global translation
  best = results[which.max(results$correlation), ]

  offset_mm = best$offset_mm
  offset_steps = round(offset_mm / depth_step)

  d = depth[valid]

  # Apply global translation first
  if (offset_steps > 0) {

    reference = x1[(1 + offset_steps):length(x1)]
    target = x2[1:(length(x2) - offset_steps)]

    reference_depth = d[(1 + offset_steps):length(d)]
    target_depth = d[1:(length(d) - offset_steps)]

  } else if (offset_steps < 0) {

    reference = x1[1:(length(x1) + offset_steps)]
    target = x2[(1 - offset_steps):length(x2)]

    reference_depth = d[1:(length(d) + offset_steps)]
    target_depth = d[(1 - offset_steps):length(d)]

  } else {

    reference = x1
    target = x2

    reference_depth = d
    target_depth = d
  }

  # Maximum permitted local deformation
  window_steps = round(max_warp_mm / depth_step)

  # Constrained DTW
  alignment = dtw(
    reference,
    target,

    step.pattern = symmetricP1,

    window.type = "sakoechiba",
    window.size = window_steps,

    keep = TRUE
  )

  # Extract the warping path
  path = data.frame(
    reference_depth_mm = reference_depth[alignment$index1],
    original_target_depth_mm = target_depth[alignment$index2]
  )

  # Where each point in core 4 is mapped in core 3
  path$warped_target_depth_mm =
    path$reference_depth_mm

  # Local displacement required
  path$warp_mm =
    path$warped_target_depth_mm -
    path$original_target_depth_mm

  return(list(
    alignment = alignment,
    path = path,
    global_offset_mm = offset_mm
  ))
}

```
```{r}
dtw_result = align_cores_dtw(

)
```

```{r}

plot_dtw_mapping = function(dtw_result) {

  path = dtw_result$path

  ggplot(
    path,
    aes(
      x = original_target_depth_mm,
      y = warped_target_depth_mm
    )
  ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "DTW depth transformation of MI-24-04B",
      x = "Original MI-24-04B depth (mm)",
      y = "Corresponding MI-24-03B depth (mm)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11)
}

plot_dtw_mapping(dtw_result)
```

```{r}
pearson_after_dtw = function(
  x1,
  x2,
  dtw_result
) {

  alignment = dtw_result$alignment

  # Values paired by the DTW warping path
  reference_values = x1[alignment$index1]
  warped_values = x2[alignment$index2]

  # Pearson correlation after DTW alignment
  r = cor(
    reference_values,
    warped_values,
    method = "pearson",
    use = "complete.obs"
  )

  return(r)
}


pearson_after_dtw(
  x1,
  x2,
  dtw_result
)
```
